I am currently a phd student at Boston University researching and teaching statistics. I help develop bespoke statistical models for a variety of scientific disciplines with a focus on methodologies for efficient inference. Please see my google scholar page for completed research. If you are interested in working with me at Boston University, please reach out for statistical consulting [here](https://www.bu.edu/mssp/mssp-consulting/).

Before joining Boston University, I worked in industry for about 10 years in Biotech, Pharma, Agriculture, and Labor Market industries. You can learn more about my past work on my [linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dan-cunha/) page. If you are interested in consulting, please reach out to me on linkedin.
